intro: Painters, writers, buildings, and how to say who made what, and when.
p.cuadro.consejo: It is masculine: «un cuadro». It hangs on the wall of a museum or a home.
p.pintor.consejo: Feminine: «pintora». It ends in -or, like «escritor» and «director».
p.novela.consejo: It is feminine. It is written with v, although it sounds like b.
p.canción.consejo: It has an accent on the o: «kan-THYON». The plural, «canciones», has no accent.
p.director.consejo: Feminine: «directora». It comes from «dirigir», and the g sounds h.
p.museo.consejo: It has three syllables: «mu-SE-o». It is masculine.
p.siglo.consejo: The twentieth century runs from 1901 to 2000. It is written «siglo XX».
p.pintar.consejo: It is regular. The «él» past form is «pintó», with an accent.
p.escribir.consejo: The «él» past form is «escribió», with an accent on the o.
p.famoso.consejo: Feminine: «famosa». You say «muy famoso», never «mucho famoso».
p.precioso.consejo: Feminine: «preciosa». C before i sounds «th» in Spain: «pre-THYO-so».
p.palacio.consejo: C before i sounds «th» in Spain: «pa-LA-thyo». It is masculine.
p.castillo.consejo: The «ll» sounds like y: «kas-TI-yo». Many are in high places.
b1.texto:
To say who made a work you use **de**: un cuadro **de** Velázquez, una novela **de** Cervantes. **¿De quién es?** — **Es de** Gaudí.

For a finished action you use the **pretérito indefinido**: lo **pintó** Velázquez; la **escribió** Cervantes.

Dates: **en** 1656; **en el siglo** diecisiete. Centuries are written with Roman numerals: **siglo XVII** is read **siglo diecisiete**.

Jobs in the arts: **pintor/pintora**, **escritor/escritora**, **director/directora**, **actor/actriz**; **artista** is the same for men and women.

To give an opinion: es **precioso**, **impresionante**, **muy famoso**; **me encanta**.
b2.f4.texto: It is in a museum in Madrid.
b2.f6.texto: Cervantes wrote it in the seventeenth century.
b2.f8.texto: The palaces of the Alhambra are beautiful.
b4.texto:
Three ideas for talking about a work:

- **de** + author: **una novela de Cervantes**, **es de Gaudí**.
- **pretérito indefinido** for what is finished: **pintó**, **escribió**, **dirigió**.
- **en** + date: **en 1656**, **en el siglo diecisiete**.

The object **lo / la** goes before the verb and the author usually comes after: **Lo pintó Velázquez.**
b4.e2.texto: The director directed the film in 2015.
b5.f0.texto: The rooms of the museum keep a cool, deep silence.
b5.f1.texto: The soft light falls from the ceiling onto the old paintings.
b5.f2.texto: A group of children looks at a portrait with their eyes wide open.
b5.f3.texto: The red and golden colours shine on the heavy frame.
b5.f4.texto: A woman writes notes in a small notebook.
b5.f5.texto: Outside the museum, an old castle overlooks the green hill.
b5.f6.texto: Its towers of pale stone cut the blue sky.
b5.f7.texto: A young musician plays a slow song next to the door.
b5.f8.texto: The notes rise through the air like birds of glass.
b5.f9.texto: The people listen in silence under the long shadows of the afternoon.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Well done! The author goes with «de»: un cuadro de Velázquez.
b6.o1.refuerzo: «Por» is used in another structure. For the author you say «de».
b6.o2.refuerzo: «A» does not show the author. You say «un cuadro de».
b7.o1.refuerzo: That's it! The indefinido «pintó» speaks of a finished action.
b7.o2.refuerzo: «Pintaba» describes something habitual or in progress, not a finished action.
b7.pregunta: Which form says Velázquez finished the painting?
b8.frase: Es una novela muy famosa en español
b8.traduccion: It is a very famous novel in Spanish
b9.o0.refuerzo: Yes! A century is a hundred years, and the seventeenth runs from 1601 to 1700.
b9.o1.refuerzo: A century is not seventeen years, but a hundred.
b9.o2.refuerzo: «Siglo» is a period of a hundred years, not one year.
b9.pregunta: Which years does the seventeenth century cover?
b10.o0.refuerzo: «Escribo» is «I write». Cervantes is another person.
b10.o1.refuerzo: «Escribía» is a past habit. Here there is a finished action.
b10.pregunta: Which form of «escribir» goes with Cervantes?
b11.pregunta: Write in Spanish: «a novel by Cervantes».
b12.o0.refuerzo: Well done! Words in -or add -a: pintora.
b12.o1.refuerzo: That is the masculine form. For a woman: «pintora».
b12.o2.refuerzo: That word does not exist. The feminine is «pintora».
p.pintó.consejo: Third person past of «pintar». The tilde marks the stress on «TÓ».
p.escribió.consejo: Past tense of «escribir». The «io» is a diphthong and the «v» sounds like «b».
p.diecisiete.consejo: The «c» before «i» is «th» in Spain. Seventeen is «diez y siete».
p.palacios.consejo: The «c» before «i» is «th». The stress is on «LA».
p.preciosos.consejo: The «c» before «i» is «th», so it is «pre-THYO-sos».
p.famosa.consejo: Feminine of «famoso». The stress is on «MO».
p.dirigió.consejo: The «g» before «i» is «h». The tilde shows the stress on «yó».
p.salas.consejo: Plural of «sala». Think of exhibition halls in a museum.
p.guardan.consejo: The «gua» is «gwa». The verb is «guardar», to keep or to store.
p.dorados.consejo: Masculine plural of «dorado». It comes from «oro».
p.domina.consejo: The stress is on «DO». The verb is «dominar», to dominate or to overlook.
p.torres.consejo: The «rr» at the start is strong: «TO-rres».
p.músico.consejo: The tilde on «ú» marks the stress. Feminine is «música» for music.
p.lenta.consejo: Feminine of «lento». The stress is on «LEN».
p.pintora.consejo: Feminine of «pintor». The «r» between vowels is soft.
p.profundo.consejo: The «d» between vowels is soft. Think of a deep, quiet silence.
p.cortan.consejo: From «cortar». The «c» before «o» is hard, like «k». Stress is on the first syllable.
